description: This file defines a template class 'MessageDataBufferType' within the WPEFramework::Messaging namespace. It manages inter-process communication buffers, including cyclic buffers with doorbell signaling for synchronization. The class provides methods for pushing and popping data, handling buffer initialization, and managing filenames for buffer files. It also defines an internal 'DataBuffer' class that extends 'Core::CyclicBuffer' with additional signaling capabilities.

classes.name: MessageDataBufferType
classes.description: A template class managing a cyclic buffer with doorbell signaling for inter-process communication, including buffer initialization, data push/pop, and filename management.

classes.name: DataBuffer
classes.description: An internal class extending 'Core::CyclicBuffer' with additional methods for signaling, waiting, and unlinking, used within 'MessageDataBufferType'.

methods.name: PushData
methods.description: Writes data into the cyclic buffer, including a length header, and rings the doorbell to notify the other process.

methods.name: PopData
methods.description: Reads data from the cyclic buffer after a doorbell ring, handling partial reads if buffer is too small.

methods.name: Ring
methods.description: Signals that data is available by ringing the doorbell.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the doorbell signal within a specified timeout.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the cyclic buffer is valid.
